max_co.rule: Max Courant is not a speed setting on its own. With 1 outer corrector (PISO) keep it at or below 1; 2-3 outer correctors allow up to about 5.
max_co.more: Largest cell Courant number the adjustable time step allows. Above 1 the steps are larger only if each has 2-3 outer correctors, and each step then costs about that many times more; without them the run becomes unstable.

n_outer_correctors.rule: PIMPLE outer loops per time step. 1 = PISO: keep Max Courant at or below 1. 2-3 allow up to about 5, and each step then costs about that many times more.
n_outer_correctors.more: More than 1 pays off only with Max Courant above 1.

grad_limiter.rule: How strongly gradients are limited: Strong is the most stable, None the most accurate on a good mesh.
grad_limiter.more: Blank uses the Numerics preset's (Strong for Robust, Light for Accurate), or Strong in a transient study without a preset.

momentum_convection.rule: The velocity convection scheme. Second order (linearUpwind) is the default; first order is more stable but less accurate.
momentum_convection.more: Steady runs write it bounded. Second order, limited (limitedLinearV) lies between the two.

turbulence_convection.rule: The turbulence equations' convection scheme: first order is more stable, second order more accurate.
turbulence_convection.more: Blank uses the Numerics preset's (first order for Robust, second for Accurate), or second order in a transient study without a preset. A laminar run solves no turbulence equations.

energy_convection.rule: The energy equation's convection scheme. Second order (limitedLinear) is the default in both presets.
energy_convection.more: First order is more stable but smears temperature fronts.

non_orth_correction.rule: How face gradients are corrected for non-orthogonal cells: Full suits a good mesh, Limited is safer on skewed cells.
non_orth_correction.more: Blank uses the Numerics preset's (Limited 0.5 for Robust, Full for Accurate), or Limited 0.5 in a transient study without a preset. None ignores non-orthogonality.

p_tolerance.rule: The pressure solver stops once its residual is below this tolerance, or has fallen by its relative tolerance.

p_rel_tol.rule: The pressure solver also stops once its residual has fallen to this fraction of its start (0 to 0.5).
p_rel_tol.more: 0.01 is the default; the final loop of a transient time step always uses 0.

p_max_iter.rule: Most pressure solver iterations per solve. At the limit on most steps: the time step is too large or the mesh is poor.
p_max_iter.more: Raising it hides that. 200 is the default.

eq_tolerance.rule: The velocity and turbulence (and energy) solvers stop once their residual is below this tolerance.
eq_tolerance.more: Or once it has fallen by their relative tolerance. 1e-8 is the default.

eq_rel_tol.rule: The velocity and turbulence (and energy) solvers also stop once their residual has fallen to this fraction (0 to 0.5).
eq_rel_tol.more: 0.1 is the default; the final loop of a transient time step always uses 0.

eq_max_iter.rule: Most velocity and turbulence (and energy) solver iterations per solve. At the limit on most steps: the step or mesh is the cause.

relax_turbulence.rule: Under-relaxation of the turbulence equations (above 0, at most 1). Blank uses Relaxation U.
relax_turbulence.more: Lower it alone when k or omega oscillate while the velocity settles.

velocity_limit.rule: Caps the velocity in every cell (limitVelocity). Automatic is 10 x the reference speed, at least 50 m/s; Off caps nothing.
velocity_limit.more: Clipping after the first steps means the run is unstable and its results there are not physical: fix the cause, never raise or remove the cap to hide it.

velocity_limit_max.rule: The custom velocity limit in m/s (above 0).
velocity_limit_max.more: Used only when Velocity limit is Custom.

outer_relax_p.rule: Pressure under-relaxation in each time step's outer loops (above 0, at most 1). Used only with 2 or more outer correctors.
outer_relax_p.more: The final outer loop always uses 1.

outer_relax_eq.rule: Under-relaxation of the other equations in each time step's outer loops (above 0, at most 1). Used with 2 or more outer correctors.
outer_relax_eq.more: The final outer loop always uses 1.

outer_tolerance.rule: Ends a time step's outer loops early once every residual is below it (1e-6 to 0.1). Used only with 2 or more outer correctors.
outer_tolerance.more: Blank runs every outer corrector on every step.
